correctness.rationale: Each obstruction is direct. For the one-vertex one-loop graph, the vertex idempotent is the identity of a Laurent polynomial Kumjian-Pask algebra, so its corner is not scalar. For a proper finite hereditary corner B=eAe, A viewed as a right B-module is not unital because Ae is a proper subset of A, and balanced tensors satisfy A tensor_B V is naturally Ae tensor_B V. For a Hausdorff ample groupoid, a singleton isotropy point mass is locally constant exactly when the unit singleton is open: local constancy of 1_{gamma} forces {gamma} open and the étale source map then forces {x} open; conversely an open singleton unit cuts a compact open bisection down to {gamma}. The one-vertex two-loop graph gives the required nonisolated path example.
